def test_configure_error_policy():
    from flask import Flask
    from error_policy import configure_error_policy
    app = Flask('test_err')
    class CustomErr(Exception):
        pass
    configure_error_policy(app, CustomErr)
    assert CustomErr in app.error_handler_spec[None][None]
